propositions: Current clarity measure rewards volume and legacy per-type shape rather than author-guide contract compliance, allowing padded plans to pass with missing required sections
Clarity scoring logic is duplicated across two code locations (_engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py) without shared abstraction, creating drift risk
Deterministic checks for required-section shape, per-AC verification coverage, placeholder-free executable scope, and grounded edit-set can be mechanically tested without semantic LLM judgment

Author-facing guidance conflicts with active plan-review criteria regarding Success Criteria (collapsed to Acceptance Criteria) and rejected-alternative requirements (only positive rationale required)
Seven-point length-and-bullet-based clarity scale conflates volume with quality and should be replaced with named applicable checks returning per-check evidence
